headline: A 2016 law lets the Department of Veterans Affairs transfer Building Number 48 at its Illiana Health Care System in Danville, Illinois, to Danville Area Community College in exchange for College land.
what_it_does: The law allows the VA to give up federal ownership of Building Number 48, along with its improvements, which is part of the VA Illiana Health Care System. In return, the College must transfer to the United States certain land and improvements near its Library Building. The summary does not list property values or give a timeline for the exchange.

who_it_affects.how: The College would receive ownership of Building Number 48 and would have to give the United States its land and improvements near the College Library Building.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Veterans Affairs and the Illiana Health Care System
who_it_affects.how: The VA would stop owning Building Number 48 and would take ownership of the College property offered in exchange.

when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not state a date for the transfer. The law was enacted on February 29, 2016.
